# OxfordPAT.co.uk

Online Oxford PAT and ESAT preparation courses. Small groups. Taught by Dr Anthony Korte (Oxford First, UCL MSc, Imperial College PhD).

## What this site covers

- Intensive online preparation for the Oxford Physics Aptitude Test (PAT)
- Intensive online preparation for the ESAT (Engineering and Science Admissions Test)
- Required for Oxford, Cambridge and Imperial College applications to Physics, Engineering, and related courses
- Small group tuition via Zoom
- Mathematics 1, Mathematics 2, and Physics modules covered in full
- Year 12 and Year 13 students

## Tutor

Dr Anthony Korte — First Class degree in Physics (University of Oxford, ranked 2nd worldwide in entrance examinations), MSc with Distinction in Mathematical Modelling (UCL), PhD in Theoretical Physics (Imperial College London). Member of the Institute of Physics (MInstP).

## September 2026 Dates

- 19–20 September 2026: 2-day Maths & Physics — £295
- 19 September 2026: 1-day Maths — £195
- 20 September 2026: 1-day Physics — £195
- 1-to-1 tuition: £70/hour (ongoing)
